checks.finding: SIGINT and SIGTERM register synchronously; registration errors propagate; no unsafe/custom handler or added dependency.
checks.name: unix_synchronous_handlers

checks.finding: Either signal wakes recv; None maps to BrokenPipe, never successful termination.
checks.name: stream_closure_error

checks.finding: Handlers precede output thread, backend and listener.
checks.name: virtual_before_resources

checks.finding: Pure selection/policy validation precedes handlers; helper I/O and FD acquisition follow handlers.
checks.name: physical_before_io

checks.finding: Only prepare competes with signal. Accepted helper operations or already-running spawn_blocking initialization may continue; no IMPORT/driver claims occur during from_sources.
checks.name: cancel_prepare_without_listener

checks.finding: Bind is directly awaited, so a ready ServerHandle is not dropped by an outer signal select. Pending registered signals are then consumed before operations via biased select.
checks.name: no_bind_cancellation_race

checks.finding: Failure to create output thread occurs before a listener exists.
checks.name: output_creation_before_bind

checks.finding: Result is captured rather than propagated out of the operation select; shutdown is awaited before propagating operation errors.
checks.name: operations_always_cleanup

checks.finding: cleanup/shutdown ? precedes result ?, preserving cleanup failure over a simultaneous output/control/signal error.
checks.name: cleanup_error_priority

checks.finding: Signal object remains in scope while shutdown awaits; shutdown is not raced with a repeated signal. Notifications may coalesce.
checks.name: repeated_signal_keeps_cleanup_alive

checks.finding: Cancelled EventOutput future leaves in_flight true; after cleanup the same blocked sink is not written again.
checks.name: blocked_stdout_no_second_write

checks.finding: A final stopped event is raced against the same still-live signal object, after cleanup only.
checks.name: stopped_output_signal_cancellable

checks.finding: Virtual/physical commands call run directly; generic outer Ctrl-C select and stdout JSON fallback do not apply to server commands.
checks.name: main_does_not_cancel_server_tree

checks.finding: Unix types/fields/recv are cfg-gated; non-Unix keeps ctrl_c branch and an empty valid signal object. Source review only; no cross-platform compile was performed.
checks.name: nonunix_source_cfg

checks.finding: Existing shutdown sends stop, joins listener; listener aborts+joins network tree then awaits settle_closed with existing cleanup deadline. This patch does not replace cleanup with process/socket close.
checks.name: backend_cleanup_dependency

checks.finding: Server errors still log stderr, without JSON stdout fallback. No promise is made that arbitrary blocked stderr exits within a bound.
checks.name: logging_scope_unchanged

limitations: Runtime subprocess and guest physical validation remain required; this source review is not runtime acceptance.
Prepare cancellation does not terminate already-running blocking work or roll back an accepted helper action.
SIGKILL/abort/panic and cross-process recovery remain outside this change.
Existing physical cleanup timeout/quarantine and hard-blocking ioctl limits remain; arbitrary stderr sink backpressure is not solved.
Non-Unix compatibility is a source-level cfg assessment only.
scope: Read-only independent review of another agent product implementation; not an independent review of my own harness. No builds, child tests, signals, USB, ptrace or QEMU executed.
